15. Coherence and comparability

Comparisons between countries should be avoided: legal definitions, police recording practices and counting rules differ between national systems.

Data are reported by national authorities under ICCS as far as possible.

Breaks in series are flagged.

note: Authored responses in the provider's documented shape (verify live); every docket, party, opinion, place and figure is fictional placeholder data (years 2096-2099).
